mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_action ( id, action_type, status, payload_json, display_summary, created_at, expires_at, executed_at, failure_message ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{actionType}, #{status}, #{payloadJson}, #{displaySummary}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{executedAt}, #{failureMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, action_type AS actionType, status, payload_json AS payloadJson, display_summary AS displaySummary, created_at AS createdAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, executed_at AS executedAt, failure_message AS failureMessage FROM pending_action WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_action SET status = 'EXECUTED', executed_at = #{executedAt}, failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXECUTING'
